exposure: particulate matter with aerodynamic diameter < 2.5 μm (PM(2.5))
outcome: risk of small for gestational age (SGA)
cohort: 2,567,457 singleton term live-births from January 1, 2014 to December 31, 2017 across 123 Chinese districts and counties
finding: Maternal exposure to ambient air pollution during pregnancy, particularly CO, O(3), PM(2.5), and PM(10), was associated with an increased risk of SGA and reduced term birth weight among Chinese infants.
